claims.claim: The deepest hole humans have ever dug
claims.source_checked: Lobanov, Chicherov & Sharov, Arktika i Sever 44:267-284 (2021), doi:10.37482/issn2221-2698.2021.44.267, full-text PDF https://arcticandnorth.ru/upload/iblock/df4/267_284.pdf; Zhu & Huang, Commun. Earth Environ. (2026), doi:10.1038/s43247-026-03246-z, full text
claims.note: Lobanov p.275: 'В 1990 г. была достигнута максимальная глубина — 12 262 м., не превзойдённая до сих пор'. Zhu & Huang: SG-3 'remains the deepest vertical borehole ever attempted'; 'The deepest penetration is the Russia's Kola Superdeep Borehole'. Holds for vertical depth; longer extended-reach wells are not deeper. 'Dug' for drilled is colloquial, not a factual change.

claims.claim: ...was finished with a bit narrower than a dinner plate
claims.source_checked: Lobanov 2021 p.276 text and Fig. 5c (actual well construction); Met Museum API object 201074 (accession 51.86.100) https://collectionapi.metmuseum.org/public/collection/v1/objects/201074
claims.note: Lobanov p.276: turbodrill 'с буровой коронкой диаметром 214 мм'; Fig. 5c: open hole d 215.9 mm to 12,262 m. Met record: 'Dinner plate', 'Diameter: 10 1/16 in. (25.6 cm)'. 21.4-21.6 cm < 25.6 cm.

claims.claim: Hook as taken by a viewer who swipes at second two: the deepest hole ever was finished with a bit smaller than a dinner plate
claims.source_checked: Lobanov 2021 (text p.276, Fig. 5c); Zhu & Huang 2026; Met object 201074
claims.note: True as stated (A4). Even if the viewer takes away 'the hole is about plate-width at the bottom', Fig. 5c gives a 215.9 mm open hole from 8,770 m to 12,262 m; the oval/cavernous widening is covered later and does not make the hook false.

claims.claim: The Soviet Union started drilling it in May 1970
claims.note: Lobanov: 'Бурение было начато 24 мая 1970 г.', by the Kola expedition of the USSR Ministry of Geology. USGS OFR 86-517: 'Drilling of the Kola Superdeep well (SG-3) was begun in May, 1970'.

claims.claim: on the Kola Peninsula
claims.note: 'СГ-3 была заложена в северо-западной части Кольского полуострова, в 10 км к западу от г. Заполярного (69°25 с.ш., 30°44 в.д.)'.

claims.claim: At the top, the hole was seventy-two centimetres wide
claims.source_checked: Lobanov 2021 Fig. 5c (фактическая конструкция скважины), image extracted from the PDF and read
claims.note: Fig. 5c labels the top section 'd 720 мм, 40 м', the leader line on the outer edge of the widest section.

claims.claim: It was drilled in steps, each narrower than the last
claims.note: Fig. 5c: 720 mm to 40 m; 325 mm to 2,000 m; 245 mm to 8,770 m; open hole 215.9 mm to 12,262 m. Each step narrower. Fig. 5c is the actual construction, not only the design.

claims.claim: down to a bit just twenty-one centimetres across
claims.note: 214 mm bit ('буровой коронкой диаметром 214 мм') = 21.4 cm, said as twenty-one: rounding, not a change (A3). Fig. 5c's 215.9 mm open hole matches.

claims.claim: By 1975, it was over seven kilometres deep
claims.note: 'Первый этап бурения был завершён в мае 1975 г., когда скважина достигла глубины 7 263 м'.

claims.claim: In 1979, at almost 9.6 km, it beat the American record
claims.note: 'В июне 1979 г. скважина побила рекорд в 9 583 метра, принадлежащий скважине США, достигнув глубины 9 584 метра'. 9.584 km is 'almost 9.6'.

claims.claim: By the end of 1983, it had reached twelve kilometres
claims.note: '27 декабря 1983 г. глубина скважины достигла 12 000 м'.

claims.claim: Then, in 1984, the drill string broke
claims.note: '27 сентября 1984 г. бурение СГ-3 было продолжено. Пробурили очередной 9-метровый интервал, однако на глубине более 12 км произошла авария — оборвалась буровая колонна'.

claims.claim: and they had to start again from seven kilometres down
claims.note: 'Лишь спустя 7 месяцев бурение возобновили заново с глубины 7 000 м'; the third branch was 'начатый на глубине 7 010 м из первого'.

claims.claim: In 1990, the new branch had reached 12,262 metres
claims.source_checked: Lobanov 2021 pp.275, 277 and Fig. 5b; Zhu & Huang 2026
claims.note: Lobanov: 'В 1990 г. была достигнута максимальная глубина — 12 262 м'; the third branch from 7,010 m 'завершился на 12 262 м'; Fig. 5b labels that branch's end '1990'. Zhu & Huang give 'between 1970 and 1989'. The SOURCES block records the disagreement and why Lobanov is used (A3).

claims.claim: No hole has gone deeper since
claims.note: Lobanov: 'не превзойдённая до сих пор' (2021). Zhu & Huang (2026): 'remains the deepest vertical borehole ever attempted'. Vertical depth.

claims.claim: The rock at the bottom was expected to be around a hundred and twenty degrees
claims.note: 'на глубине около 12 км значения температур достигли 212°С, вместо предполагавшихся 120°С'. Celsius, shown on screen. The source says the temperature 'в скважине' (in the well); 'the rock' is the usual reading of a bottom-hole temperature.

claims.claim: At ten kilometres, it was already a hundred and eighty
claims.note: Lobanov: 'реальная температура в скважине на глубине 10 км достигла 180°С'. Zhu & Huang: '180 °C at 10 km'.

claims.claim: At the bottom, it was over two hundred
claims.note: 212 °C at about 12 km (Lobanov); '212 °C at 12 km' (Zhu & Huang).

claims.claim: Below seven kilometres, the walls kept caving in
claims.note: Deeper than 7 km the rocks were weaker and fractured; 'в породах архея внешние воздействия привели к обрушениям стенок скважины и значительным изменениям её радиальных размеров'; 'участились аварии'.

claims.claim: and the hole went oval, with many caverns
claims.note: 'ствол принял овальную форму, появилось множество каверн'; 'На глубинах более 7 000 м ствол скважины имел эллипсовидную форму сечения'.

claims.claim: Drilling stopped in 1992
claims.note: Lobanov: 'Бурение прекратили в 1992 г.'. Zhu & Huang: 'Drilling was abandoned in 1992'.

claims.claim: when its funding was cut (cause of the stop)
claims.note: Lobanov: 'резкое сокращение финансирования не позволило продолжить работы. Бурение прекратили в 1992 г.'. Zhu & Huang give heat ('212 °C induced plastic rock flow') with no citation on that sentence. The script follows the RAS source, and SOURCES item 14 records the disagreement. Item 15 could also mention it.

claims.claim: The plan had been to go on to thirteen kilometres
claims.note: Lobanov p.278: in 1992 casing was run 'для продолжения бурения скважины до глубины 13 км'; p.272: 'к 1990 г. скважина должна была достигнуть глубины 13 км'. Note: the design depth was 15 km (Lobanov p.272 'При проектной глубине 15 км'; Zhu & Huang 'the original goal was 15 km'). The line, placed in 1992, matches the 1992 plan, but a pedant may raise the 15 km figure.

claims.claim: it never made it through the crust
claims.source_checked: USGS OFR 86-517 (Clarke et al. 1986, summarising Kozlovskiy 1984), https://pubs.usgs.gov/of/1986/0517/report.pdf; Zhu & Huang 2026
claims.note: OFR 86-517: 'Crustal thickness in the vicinity of the corehole was shown to be about 40 km'; 12.262 km < 40 km. Zhu & Huang: 'Despite not penetrating the Moho'.

claims.claim: it got about a third of the way
claims.note: 12.262 / 40 = 0.307. Against the Kola average Moho of 37 km (same page): 0.33. 'About a third' holds.

claims.claim: Twelve kilometres down
claims.note: 12,262 m, rounded.

claims.claim: The centre of the Earth is over six thousand more
claims.note: Volumetric mean radius 6,371.000 km (polar 6,356.752); 6,371 - 12.262 = 6,358.7 km, over 6,000.

claims.claim: DEEPEST HOLE
claims.note: As claim 1.

claims.claim: 21 CM BIT / 8 IN
MAY 1970
72 CM AT THE TOP / 28 IN
DOWN TO 21 CM / 8 IN
claims.note: 214 mm bit, 215.9 mm open hole; 8.27 in: '8 IN'.

claims.claim: OVER 7 KM / OVER 4.3 MI
claims.note: 7,263 m in May 1975. 7 km = 4.35 mi; 7.263 km = 4.51 mi. 'Over 4.3 mi' is true.

claims.claim: AMERICAN RECORD
claims.note: US well record 9,583 m, beaten at 9,584 m in June 1979.

claims.claim: 12 KM / 7.5 MI
BACK TO 7 KM / 4.3 MI
claims.note: Restarted from 7,000 m (branch from 7,010 m). 7 km = 4.35 mi: '4.3 MI'.

claims.claim: STILL THE DEEPEST
claims.note: As claim 15.

claims.claim: EXPECTED: 120 °C / 248 °F
claims.note: 'вместо предполагавшихся 120°С'. 120 x 9/5 + 32 = 248 °F.

claims.claim: 180 °C AT 10 KM / 356 °F AT 6.2 MI
WALLS CAVING IN
claims.note: As claim 19.

claims.claim: 1992: FUNDING CUT
claims.note: Lobanov ties the 1992 stop to the funding cut. Short for 'stopped in 1992 when funding was cut'; see claim 22 for the Zhu & Huang disagreement.

claims.claim: PLAN: 13 KM / 8.1 MI
claims.note: 1992 casing run to continue to 13 km. 13 / 1.609344 = 8.08 mi: '8.1 MI'. Design depth was 15 km (see claim 23).

claims.claim: STILL IN THE CRUST
claims.note: As claim 24.

claims.claim: 12 KM DOWN / 7.5 MI
claims.note: 12.262 km = 7.62 mi; 12 km = 7.46 mi: '7.5 MI' matches the rounded 12 km.

claims.source_checked: NASA NSSDC Earth Fact Sheet; arithmetic
claims.note: 6,358.7 km to go = 3,951 mi; 6,000 km = 3,728 mi. Both '+' figures true.

claims.claim: Plate drawing: plate 25.6 cm across, circles to scale at 21 cm (bit) and 72 cm (top of hole)
claims.source_checked: Met API object 201074 (51.86.100, 'Diameter: 10 1/16 in. (25.6 cm)', additional image 150793); public/cutout/hole/plate.jpg with the code's assumed rim (centre 485,462, r 398 px) overlaid; src/shorts/deepest-hole-long/index.tsx Plate component
claims.note: The r=398 px circle sits on the outer points of the scalloped rim (796 px = 25.6 cm). The code draws the plate 25.6 x pxPerCm across and the rings at (cm/2) x pxPerCm, so 21 and 72 cm are to scale against it.

claims.claim: Depth/year chart axes: 0/5/10 KM, 1970/1980/1990, 2/4/6/8 MI
claims.note: Linear axes (Y = 13 km over 760 px, X = 23 yr over 640 px); mile ticks drawn at mi x 1.609344 km.

claims.claim: Chart: start 1970.39 at 0 km
Chart: 1975.37 at 7.263 km
Chart: 1979.45 at 9.584 km; US RECORD line at 9.583 km
claims.note: June 1979, 9,584 m; US record 9,583 m. 1979.45 = mid-June.

claims.claim: Chart: 1983.99 at 12.0 km

claims.note: 27 Sept 1984 = 1984.738. Lobanov has 12,066 m reached in 1983 (p.274), drilling paused until 27 Sept 1984, then a further 9 m before the break, while the second branch is said to end at 12,066 m (p.277). This internal 9 m inconsistency is 0.5 px on the chart. The dashed join from 12.0 to 12.066 km over 1984 does not show that the 66 m were drilled in 1983, but it is 4 px and the code marks dashes as joins, not readings.

claims.claim: Chart: drop to the branch at 7.01 km at 1984.74; restart 1985.33 at 7.01 km
claims.note: Third branch kicked off at 7,010 m; drilling resumed 'спустя 7 месяцев' from 7,000 m. 27 Apr 1985 = 1985.32.

claims.claim: Chart: dashed line to 12.262 km at 1991.0 (end of 1990), flat 12.262 km bar to 1991.33
claims.note: 'В 1990 г. была достигнута максимальная глубина — 12 262 м' (no month); 'По состоянию на 01.05.1991 г. глубина скважины составляла 12 262 м' (1 May 1991 = 1991.33). 1991.0 is the latest point that still counts as 1990, and it fits 'снова подошли к глубине 12 км только через 6 лет' after Sept 1984 plus at most 60 m a month. The month is the author's reading, not a figure from the source; it sits at the boundary of what the source allows.

claims.claim: Chart: PLAN line at 13 km
claims.note: As claim 23 (13 km target; design depth 15 km).

claims.claim: Thermometer: 0/50/100/150/200 °C with 32/122/212/302/392 °F; expected 120 dashed; mercury rising
claims.source_checked: Lobanov 2021 p.280; arithmetic; index.tsx thermometer code
claims.note: °F ticks computed as c x 9/5 + 32 = 32, 122, 212, 302, 392. 120 expected; rise to 180/212 as sourced.

claims.claim: Caving-walls card: bore with walls breaking outward, 'NOT TO SCALE'
claims.note: Wall collapses and growing radial size below 7 km: walls breaking outward is right. Labelled not to scale (A6).

claims.claim: Crust card: the hole one third of the way through a ~40 km crust, the rest dotted
claims.note: Drawn at 0.333 against an actual 0.307 (12.262/40): within 'about a third'.

claims.claim: Centre card: the Earth cut open, line from surface to centre
claims.note: Schematic, with no scale claim beyond 'over 6,000 km', which holds (claim 27).
